summary: 25-foot pole tower with cab on Beckler Peak in Wild Sky Wilderness, begun about 1924; removed or destroyed in 1958; footings remained at a 2015 visit.

facts.design: 25-foot pole tower with a 6-by-6-foot cab and log cabin (WillhiteWeb says the tent was replaced by a 10-by-16-foot log cabin)
facts.status_note: Tower removed or destroyed in 1958 (sources differ); a 2015 visit found footings, per WillhiteWeb

staffing.status: lookout used a heliograph until a telephone line reached the ranger station; no last-staffed year in the sources read

access.note: Reached by trail in the Wild Sky Wilderness from FR-6066 near Skykomish. No closure found in the pages read

visit.drive_up: Good dirt and gravel road; from Skykomish, 3.1 miles east, then a left turn onto FR-6066 (WillhiteWeb)
visit.trail_note: WillhiteWeb describes a west-peak trail that uses old logging roads and reaches the old lookout trail near the summit. The final switchback to the site had not been cleared on his visit.

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service (Mt. Baker-Snoqualmie National Forest per firelookout.com)

events.note: Built in 1924 per the register; WillhiteWeb says use began around 1924 with a platform between three trees, later a 25-foot pole tower
Equipment and tent reportedly brought over from Cleveland Mountain in 1924 (WillhiteWeb, citing a source)
April 1930 report says the lookout saw a work train near Great Northern Bridge #412 and reported a fire there of August 1 to Skykomish Ranger Station; the excerpt does not give the fire's year
Panoramic photos taken from the lookout on August 10, 1934, at 42 feet above the ground
Register says the tower and cabin were removed in 1958
firelookout.com and WillhiteWeb say the last tower was destroyed in 1958; WillhiteWeb describes a winter storm toppling it, with no source given for that account
Registered with the Former Fire Lookout Sites register on January 26, 2012

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says the tower and cabin were removed in 1958; firelookout.com and WillhiteWeb say the last tower was destroyed in 1958. Both give 1958, so the story reports both wordings. WillhiteWeb's storm account is uncited in the page text.

WillhiteWeb suspects a third lookout structure, based on stairs and footings that do not match the old photos. This is his inference and is not stated in any other source. The story labels it as his suspicion.

sources.title: Beckler Peak Lookout Site, West Peak Trail

notes_for_editor: The brief's kind 'tower' is kept but no tower stands. Height 7.6 m is converted from the 25-foot pole tower in the register and WillhiteWeb. WillhiteWeb's 2015 visit notes and his third-structure suspicion are his own. The Washington lookouts entry carries the April 1930 fire report, which gives no fire year. The access level 'public' is an inference from the trail description; no closure was found.
